strongest_bounded_proposition: Chimú state organisation used labour taxation/corvée and captive sacrifice, but the bounded packet does not establish slavery as the correct category for those relations around 1300.
strongest_unsupported_proposition: Do not reclassify state labour taxation, attached craft production or sacrificed captives as slavery.
territorial_practice_summary: State-administered labour obligations and attached production are supported; slavery is not established.
external_network_summary: Captive-taking/sacrifice evidence does not establish slave trade.
terminology_category_qualification: Corvée, attached specialist labour, captivity and slavery must remain separate.
temporal_scope_precision: Chimú evidence directly concerns the relevant late pre-Hispanic period.
inference_extent: No inference beyond the stated target/evidence locus.
language_access_limitations: English-accessible research packet only; non-English and non-digitized scholarship was not exhaustively searched.
